arguments.question: For NVDA, MU and QQQ over 63 trading sessions, assess dated, primary-source-supported policy/geopolitical transmission risks relevant to semiconductor supply, China/export controls, and cross-border demand. Distinguish policy facts from possible revenue/supply-chain effects; state symbol-specific evidence that would change the relative assessment. Use the registered BIS-policy and company disclosures where available; stop after the latest material policy document plus pertinent disclosures. Do not infer unreported geographic exposure.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether export-control or geopolitical shocks create a differentiated downside risk for NVDA or MU relative to diversified QQQ.
